About

A developer who values curiosity and craft in equal measure.

I've spent the last eight years building for the web — from marketing sites to data-heavy applications. I care about the details most people never notice: the easing on a transition, a keyboard trap that shouldn't exist, a layout that holds up on every screen.

Away from client work, I throw pottery and shoot film. Those hobbies keep my hands busy and my eye sharp, and they quietly shape how I approach design and problem-solving.
